what: Packaging Corporation of America makes containerboard and turns it into corrugated cardboard boxes. It runs paper mills and more than a hundred box plants across the United States.
customers: Food and beverage producers, e-commerce shippers, agricultural packers and general manufacturers.
moat: Mills integrated with its own box plants, so it controls cost from pulp to finished box, with the highest margins in the US containerboard industry.
risks: Containerboard prices are cyclical and drive earnings
Box demand follows consumer goods volumes
Recycled fibre and energy costs are volatile
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 12% operating margin
E-commerce shipping supports long-term box demand
A dividend yield around 2.5% with consistent increases
watch: Box shipments per day and containerboard pricing.
